newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Escudo gains on mark, lifted by stronger dollar.
newsitem.headline: Escudo gains on mark, lifted by stronger dollar.

text.p: The escudo was slightly firmer on the mark in early trade on Wednesday, following the trend of the other European crosses which were being lifted against the German currency by the firm trend of the dollar, traders said.
The currency was trading at 100.90/93 to the mark against its 100.97/00 close on Tuesday. Traders predicted a range of 100.80-101.00 for the currency on Wednesday.
"The dollar is very strong and European currencies gained room to appreciate against the mark," said one trader.
